name: card
accessibility: No role of its own; give it a CardTitle (a real heading, `level`) for structure. An `interactive` card needs a single link or button inside that names it.
example:
<Card variant="outline">
  <CardIcon><Layers /></CardIcon>
  <CardTitle level={3}>Token-driven theming</CardTitle>
  <CardDescription>Swap brands and modes from one set of variables.</CardDescription>
</Card>
